notes.title: 1.0.5 rollback
notes.content: Hey everybody, I'm so sorry, the recent 1.0.6 patch included me having to update some back end and I severely underestimated how many issues it would cause.  I'm rolling back the game to 1.0.5 until I can get a proper 1.0.6 working.  The silver lining is that if you launched 1.0.6 you might still get some of the unlocks at least ^^;;;

notes.title: 1.0.6 - quick changes
notes.content:
The Sisters secret character now unlocks at a combined Ace level of 12, down from 26
The Irolaz secret character now unlocks at a combined Ace level of 18, down from 36

The Rugana/Angelique storyline now unlocks at a combined Ace level of 8, down from Rugana 13.


Some quick changes to content access to open up this stuff for what I hope will be the vast majority of players :]  I definitely think these barriers were erected a little bit too high

[p]Bug Fixes:
Fixed a bug where if the Sisters or Irolaz purchased Trapezoid Scheme it wouldn't give them any shields
Fixed a bug with the Aether Chain card where it wasn't drawing any cards.
Fixed a card text error where Gardener said it caused CREEP (it's not supposed to)
Fixed some more tooltip overlay layering with the Armory and the "Pick for Me" button
More Typos and portrait issues in story content
Fixed a rare crash associated with the Dark manifestations from Ace Difficulty 21+

Changes:

One of the map layouts for Act 3 Fight 2 had a Hybrid Korblian Cruiser removed, replaced with a  Hybrid Korblian Frigate (this will make the fight easier)

Many passives had minor price adjustments.

Rugana:

Cards:

Rapid Reassembly removed from Tier 2, replaced with new card Mine Blast.

Mine Blast: 4 cost. \[Hunting, Ally, Shrapnel]

14 Damage, Scatter 2 Mines in the area
+1 Mine per target Struck

'Slinger' Mk2 removed from Tier 2, replaced with 'Scrappy'

'Scrappy': 9 cost. \[Engineering, Assemble, Ally]
Spawn An Assembler.
HP: 45, Range: 8
Turn End: Create a random ASSEMBLED card in deck
INTERACT(1):
Move an ASSEMBLED card in the VOID into your Deck and Discard
(Two total cards are moved, one to each)

Assemble Crash Dart removed from Tier 3, replaced with Rapid Reassembly with no changes.

Passives:

Engineering Expert requirement to activate reduced to 20 energy spent from 28.  Only the first eight Scrap Grenades fired by this passives each turn will create a SPARE PART

(This passive was a little too hard to activate while also having some pseudo-infinite potential once it was activated.)

Llari:

Passives:

Spirit Knife now creates a max of 5 0-cost Spirit shards per turn up from 3

Frostfire Mastery now creates a minimum of 1 Frostfire Bolt assuming you have at least 1 BLAZE or BLIZZARD

Aethersoul Mastery was reworked, now reads:
Aether damage you deal to enemies now grants Fire Armor as though you had dealt 20% of that damage to yourself as Fire Damage.

Cyllwyynavva:

Passives:

New passive: Cyllwyynavva - The Tarqael’s Thorns
Playing 8 REACTIVE cards grants REACTIVE: every 3 activations, fire thorns at all enemies within 6 range. Damage is equal to ½ of the number of REACTIVE cards played.

Fleeting Aqua & Fleeting Arbor now both activate on the first 4 OBLITERATES Water/Wood cards played per turn up from 3

Sisters:

Passives:

Flying Circles Around Them now also grants 1 energy when it activates

Berserker: The B.H. Axe created by this passive now costs 4 energy, down from 5

Blessed: This passive will no longer activate if the current Lunar Blessing is Curse of the New Moon.

Dominate the Skies:
The “The Sky Axe” cards created by this passive have their BUFFET and Damage increased to 30 from 23

Combo Attack: Slicing Tornado:
The card created by this passive now draws 2 cards instead of 1

Combo Attack: Celestial Enmity.
The card created by this passive now refunds 3 energy.  Upgrading this card via playing additional card fragments increases the energy refund as well.

Irolaz & Skraawwna:

RAPTURE tweaked some more.  Damage starts at 100 and scales up 10 every time you suffer damage from RAPTURE. Ending your turn while in the RAPTURE state exits the state safely.

Passives:

Apocalypse Waiting Room reworked.  Ending your turn in the RAPTURE state grants 1 energy per unused activation of RAPTURE.  This energy will be available to use next turn

Darkened Horizon, now reads: On turn start, if your current RAPTURE damage is 140 or higher, draw 4 cards and reduce their cost by 1

Trapezoid scheme now grants 15 gold per combat instead of 10 (only for this character.)

Obsessed with Me now causes damage equal to 80% of valid targets’ SEDUCED damage up from 50%

Can’t Take Our Joy reworked.  Now Reads:
Your minimum SIN is 15.  Activating REVEL increases the minimum by 5.  The highest the minimum can be is 40

Avian Ferocity cost of created Gouge decreased to 2, now causes DRAIN(5) instead of DRAIN(6).  The Gouge created by this card has 60% SINFUL applied to it.

[/p]

QOL updates:

Added a button to the right of your character portrait that pings your ship

Added a button to the draft screen that lets you view the full-sized versions of draftable cards rather than the half-compressed version.  This is admittedly a bit of a band-aid fix for the poor readability of the half-compressed cards, I'd like to get something more robust in there if I can find the time to totally overhaul that screen.



Bug Fixes:

Fixed a variety of cards having incorrect icons/flags/tools that should be associated with their archetypes or keywords.

Llari:
Fixed a crash associated with loading temporary saves of hers and other crashes of a similar types.  Hopefully this resolves the "crashed while loading" error.

Smoke:

Fixed a bug where certain enemies would hit Smoke's mirages with electrified tethers but then deal damage to the Umbral Shiv instead.

Fixed issues with Smoke's SUBROUTINE display not paginating correctly at larger numbers of SUBROUTINES.

Fixed a bug with loading a save file with a card that had the Pursued modifier not having SEEK anymore.

Fixed a bug where the Devious passive could sometimes lower a card's cost below 0

Irolaz:

Fixed a bug where the Jack of Diamonds would cause too much DRAIN.

Bug Fixes:
(Some of these have been live for a few days)

Fixed a bug with Time Breach where the created TEMPORAL wasn't always being generated on top of your ship
Fixed a bug with Time Dilation where it wasn't creating the Conjure Temporal in your deck
Fixed a bug where the passive components of hired Mercenaries weren't loading using the temporary save functionality.  This was affecting Rhyillcyyen (Eminent Assistance), Rukr (Contingency), Dalae (Combo Guard), and Ocelio(Mystery Cards) (big thanks to the person who reported this to me)
Fixed some tooltips overlapping the options menu in the armory.
Fixed an issue where a card with the Patient modifier wouldn't retain AFFIXED when loading a saved run
Fixed a bug with All Hands! where it was turning into a Shield Boost if you loaded a saved run
Fixed a visual bug with several Rugana cards where if you increased their damage permanently, the card text would revert to the base damage numbers when loading a saved run

Gameplay Changes:
Irolaz:

I continue to fiddle with RAPTURE.

RAPTURE damage now starts at 100 again, up from 70

On turn end, if you're in the RAPTURE state, the counter will increase by 2 uses, up to the max.
Apocalypse Waiting Room now specifies that it increases this functionality to 4 uses per turn up from 2

Some minor and medium reworks to the unlockable characters, Sisters and Irolaz going live today.

Sisters:

The Sisters' UI has been readjusted and it now has a button on it which allows you to pay 4 energy to draw a Card Fragment (the pieces of SHATTER cards). This button can be pressed once per turn per SHATTER card that started in your deck.

ultimately I expect this to be a nice improvement for very early game SHATTER gameplay, and very niche lategame.

Irolaz:

your maximum NEGATIVITY now starts combats at 10.  For every 4 points of DRAIN that overflow your maximum or points of NEGATIVITY that actually deal damage to you, the Max increases by 1.

This should make NEGATIVITY and DRAIN easier to cheat value out of early game and midgame, but late game it will allow a heavy DRAIN based build to remain a threat to your health if mismanaged.

RAPTURE has been completely reworked, old functionality discarded.  RAPTURE now reads:
Enter the RAPTURE state, causing your cards to refund 2 energy after they are played.  After playing 6 cards, exit the RAPTURE state and take 100 damage.  Whenever you take damage from RAPTURE, this damage increases by 50.

Eviscerate, Worship Me, Coin Of The End, Doomsday, FORBIDDEN Rapture, and Clemency have all been improved or had their cost reduced.

Defy Fate, Zeal Tap, Dark Lashings, Doom Whisper, The King of Clubs, Bluff, and Deck Tap were all reworked to cause the RAPTURE effect, most of them maintain their old effects.

Added Four new passives that interact with RAPTURE: Bleak Rapture, Apocalypse Waiting Room, Darkened Horizon, and Royal Rapture.

This patch will NOT brick existing runs that were suspended with the temporary save system.  However, the modified Cards will retain their old energy costs and damage numbers.

EDIT:
Quick patch on the 7th.
RAPTURE initial damage reduced to 70, scaling reduced to 30.
Darkened Horizon requires 190 RAPTURE damage to activate
FORBIDDEN Rapture now VOIDS properly

A few of these have been live for a few days as I've been patching bugs as they're reported to me but here's an aggregated list.

Fixed a bug with text layering during the between-combat boardgames
Fixed a crash with Fkaassuurrun's card 'Charclaw.'
Fixed a bug with the Sisters card 'Eject Sympathizers' where it wasn't requiring the conditions associated with GUARDIAN to trigger GUARDIAN.
Some typos
Fixed a bug where combat 3-1 never had story chatter triggering and was instead triggering on 3-2.  3-2's story chatter was not triggering at all
Fixed a bug with Llari's card 'Meltdown' where it would crash the game if you right clicked it.
Fixed the Smoke card 'Skulk''s associated tooltips


Reworked (buffed) Cyllwyynavva's passive 'Pressurized' with no cost increase.

EDIT:

Updating this post with some changes that went live tonight (the 31st) thanks to people reporting these to me <3

Fixed a crash associated with triggering PREDATOR with a passive that generates its own Shrapnel such as Sturdy Casings or Shrapnel Ghosts when you also had the Glass Shrapnel and Study Prey passives.

Fixed a crash with Defective Spitfire Beam (both Llari and Rugana), Storm of Vengeance, Peal of Thunder, and Razor Leaf, if these effects would try to fire when the only enemy on the battlesky was Invulnerable (aka the last boss during phase transition)
